Retest PARTIAL — 8 Nov 2026

Environment: staging-desk.taviportal.com, tenant NDC-Staging, Edge (headless) + API; owner, agents Mahmoud Samy (A2) and Dev Team 2 (A3) signed in, Test User 1 (A1) offline · QA AS6 Dept A / Dept B, team QA AS6 Team A
Method: API and screen

The fix works: round robin now assigns tickets on create. Two items are still open: the threshold can be exceeded by one when tickets arrive at the same moment (NF-3), and import has no way to run assignment rules (GEN-13).

Checked: round robin on create

  • New Ticket form, Ticket Owner cleared (the failing step) → Form sends owner null; #1660 → A2 by rule "QA RT15 2275 seq", trigger "A new ticket" [PASS]
  • API create, owner null / source "api" with no owner → #1439 → A2, #1440 → A3 [PASS]
  • Web form, real iframe submission (GEN-13) → #1668 → A3 by the rule; no matching rule: #1669 Unassigned [PASS]
  • Form with owner left as shown; ticket created with an owner → #1662 stays with the signed-in agent; #1442 stays A1 [PASS]
  • Pool offline at create → #1444 Unassigned [PASS]

Checked: round robin

  • Sequential, 3 agents, 6 tickets on create → A1, A2, A3, A1, A2, A3 [PASS]
  • A1 offline, 4 tickets → A2, A3, A2, A3; History shows "Test User 1 (SKIPPED)" when A1's turn was passed (#1661) [PASS]
  • Load based (open tickets A2 88, A3 74) → A3, A3, A3, A3 [PASS]
  • Skill added on create + skill round robin → #1469 got skill QA AS6 sk2 → A2 (holds the skill) [PASS]
  • Two round robin rules match → A2, A2; second rule (A3) never used [PASS]
  • Threshold over limit; agent threshold overrides; switch off keeps the row → Waits; A2 = 200 got A2, A2, A2; row kept and ticket waits [PASS]
  • Assign backlogs → Next backlog ticket to A2 in 34 s (oldest first, #1345) [PASS]
  • Assign tickets on closure → A2 at threshold closes #1687 → waiting #1689 to A2 in 1.8 s, trigger backlog [PASS]
  • Both backlog options off → A2 closes #1688, A2's open count 159 → 158, #1690 still waiting after 20 s [PASS]
  • Incoming mode "backlog first" → #1664 Unassigned at 4 s, A2 at about 110 s, trigger backlog (run limit raised to 50 so older waiting QA tickets would not hold it up) [PASS]

Checked: direct rules and execution order

  • Direct + round robin both match → #1457 → A1, no round robin entry; A1 is offline and still assigned [PASS]
  • Direct: preset owner; Mark as Unassigned → #1458 stays A3; #1464 Unassigned [PASS]
  • Direct moves to Dept A unassigned, Dept A round robin → #1461 → A2, entries "direct" then "round robin", trigger "moved" [PASS]
  • Direct rule on Ticket Update → Unowned → A2 after the update; owned stays A3 [PASS]
  • Direct to team → #1460 team QA AS6 Team A; A2 and A3 one team notice each [PASS]
  • EO-2 workflow "owner is A1" after direct rule → #1509 direct A1, then the workflow set A3 [PASS]
  • EO-3 workflow sets owner, round robin also matches → #1510 A3, no round robin entry [PASS]
  • EO-4/5 direct A2, then workflow A3 → #1511 History A2 then A3; A3 notified, A2 not [PASS]
  • Direct master switch off / on (rules stay listed) → #1455 Unassigned; #1456 → A2; both changes in the Audit Log [PASS]
  • Speed (NF-4) → Direct: at first read. Round robin: 0.7 to 2.0 s after the create returned, 8 tickets [PASS]

Still failing

  • NF-3: 20 tickets created at the same moment, pool of 2, each with room for 5, 5 runs: expected 5, 5 and 10 waiting, every run; actual Run 1: 6, 5, 9 · run 2: 5, 5, 10 · run 3: 5, 5, 10 · run 4: 5, 6, 9 · run 5: 5, 5, 10. One agent went one over the threshold in 2 of 5 runs. No ticket had two assignment entries.

To decide

  • GEN-13: import with rules on: the requirement says "import (rules on) is assigned by the same matching rule"; actual The Assign step has no rule to choose, only "Trigger automation and process management". No-owner rows go to the importer, box ticked or not: #1681, #1682, #1683, #1684. The 6 Nov fix note says the importer rule is intended.

Notes

  • A plain API create with no owner and no source now goes to its creator (#1441). The 6 Nov fix note said it would stay unassigned; NDC-2813 changed this on 8 Nov and says so.
  • Round robin assigns just after the create returns, so the create response has no owner yet. NF-4's 5-second target is met, but NF-4 also says nobody sees the ticket unassigned first.
  • History still shows the owner change twice ("Ticket Owner was updated" and "Ticket owner was changed"), as marked in the last retest.

Not run

  • Tickets arriving by email: left out for now, as agreed.
  • 30-day rule: tickets cannot be aged on staging.
  • Not repeated today, passed on 6–7 Nov: rule form validation, criteria operators and fields, agent removed from a rule, Arabic, keyboard names, stale save, conversion of old rules, department alerts.

Evidence: NDC-2275-retest-PARTIAL.png (attached)
